en.headline: Strong Monsoon Signal remains in force under continued easterly winds
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory kept the signal active through the evening, warning of strong easterly winds, occasional gale-force gusts and rough seas, while monitoring a low-pressure area near Hainan.
body: The Strong Monsoon Signal remained in force on Wednesday evening as the Hong Kong Observatory continued to warn of strong easterly winds across the territory.

According to the Observatory, mean wind speeds exceeding 40 kilometres per hour were expected from the east, with gusts occasionally reaching gale force. Conditions were particularly rough over offshore waters, and the public was advised to stay away from the shoreline and avoid water sports.

An area of low pressure over the northern part of the South China Sea was moving westwards towards the vicinity of Hainan Island. The Observatory said it would closely monitor the system's intensity and movement and assess the need for issuing the Standby Signal, No. 1, in the coming days.
Residents not well sheltered from the east were advised to secure loose objects, while small-craft owners were told to ensure deck fittings were firmly fastened.

zh.headline: 強烈季候風信號繼續生效 偏東強風及大浪持續
zh.dek: 天文台周三晚維持強烈季候風信號，預料吹偏東強風，陣風間中達烈風程度，並密切監察南海北部低壓區動向。
body: 強烈季候風信號周三晚繼續生效，香港天文台指本港吹偏東強風，平均風速超過每小時40公里，陣風間中達烈風程度。
天文台提醒市民提防海面大浪可能帶來的危險，尤其離岸水域浪大，應遠離岸邊及停止水上活動。身在當風地方的市民應採取預防措施，花盆及可能被風吹倒的物件應搬入室內。
一個廣闊低壓區正為南海北部帶來不穩定天氣，正穩步向西移動，逐漸靠近海南島一帶。天文台會密切監察其強度及動向，評估是否需要發出一號戒備信號。
小艇艇戶應確保甲板上的物件綁緊，並採取預防措施保障小艇安全。
